title: AYNA NL dataset pair
description: One line of eval/nl/pairs.jsonl or heldout.jsonl: a Turkish test description and its gold steps (#36). Rules for every field: eval/nl/guideline.md. Checked by eval/nl/check_pairs.py.

id.description: Unique pair id: the app code, a dash and three digits. Never reused.

app.description: Application under test; eval/nl/objects/<app>.json holds its objects.

appVersion.description: Version of the app the pair was written for; must equal the objects file's appVersion.

scenario.description: Test intent the pair phrases. Pairs with the same scenario are phrasing variants: same app, type and gold steps.

style.description: Phrasing style of the text (guideline section 5).

origin.description: team: written by a team member; outsider: written by someone outside the team (#57).

author.description: Team member id, or an anonymous code ext-NN for an outsider. Never a real name.

text.description: The Turkish description exactly as written (line breaks allowed), without leading or trailing white space.

gold.description: The gold step document: a step schema document with at least one step and no step ids.

notes.description: Free text for reviewers: labelling choices, doubts. Required with a Click on a check box, to give the assumed start state (guideline section 6.8).
